title: sepsis-gp-symbolic-regression: Calibration-aware symbolic regression for interpretable sepsis mortality prediction under hospital shift
description: Code and reproducibility materials for the manuscript submitted to Artificial Intelligence in Medicine. A genetic-programming symbolic regression formula for sepsis mortality prediction is evolved with a calibration-aware objective and evaluated for discrimination and calibration transfer across eICU-CRD and MIMIC-IV, including a directional hospital-mortality tertile shift analysis.
